generationPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE finished, exceptionally simple horizontal logo for a professional news-monitoring and briefing web application called MissionDesk. It is an independent civilian information product, not a government agency or security vendor. Composition: one compact abstract symbol at left, exact wordmark 'MissionDesk' to its right, optically aligned as a single clean horizontal lockup. Symbol concept: an understated geometric M constructed from two solid folded-page forms, with a clear intentional negative-space opening that suggests bringing information into focus. Reduce the symbol to very few substantial shapes; it must remain recognizable at 24 pixels and work in one color. Do not surround it with a badge or container. Typography: beautifully drawn neutral contemporary sans serif, medium-semibold weight, normal letter spacing, precise and highly legible, capital M and capital D only, exact spelling MissionDesk. Palette: flat deep teal-green #24795D for the symbol, near-black charcoal #16191D for the wordmark. Style: restrained editorial software identity, balanced, confident, quiet and trustworthy, vector-like crisp edges, no ornamental detail. Background: genuine transparent alpha, no white background or checkerboard drawn into the image. Layout: wide horizontal composition, generous but not excessive transparent clearspace around the lockup; symbol approximately the height of the wordmark capitals or slightly taller. No slogan, no secondary text, no extra logo variants, no brand presentation sheet, no application mockup. Avoid shields, padlocks, crowns, flags, coats of arms, globes, radar circles, crosshairs, eyes, gradients, shadows, 3D, bevels and thin lines. Deliver a clean standalone production-style logo asset, not a photograph of a logo.
